en: A multi-view color postcard featuring various landmarks of Pécs, Hungary. The front side is divided into several photographs: an observation deck with scenic views, historic buildings and streets, a TV transmission tower amid greenery, the four-towered Romanesque cathedral, ornate church interiors with mosaics and frescoes, a grand square with a plague column, and a large white civic building. The word "PÉCS" is prominently printed in large white letters in the center. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with address lines, barcodes, and multilingual greetings from Pécs, with a faint background image of the cathedral's façade.
